name: OlympiadBench
description: 675 English-language open-ended mathematical olympiad problems. Corresponds to the text-only English math competition subset of Hothan/OlympiadBench, as distributed by the Qwen2.5-Math evaluation harness. Used as an evaluation target in the math SFT transfer suite (accuracy, greedy decoding).
notes: Data sourced from the Qwen2.5-Math evaluation harness at https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen2.5-Math/tree/a45202bd16f1ec06f433442dc1152d0074773465/evaluation/data. The 675-row file corresponds to the OE_TO_maths_en_COMP configuration of Hothan/OlympiadBench after filtering; it is not a verbatim HuggingFace split.
